profile.headline: Software Development Engineer at Netflix
profile.summary: I'm a software developer with 7 years of full time experience who is primarily focused on back-end engineering. I have successfully designed, led, and implemented multiple complex projects both independently and with large teams. The majority of my experience is in quickly developing scalable, well-tested and highly maintainable Java microservices. Additionally, I have loved working directly with non engineering clients and stakeholders, both internal and external to the company.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Built purchasing software with the goal of streamlining the entire internal Google purchase journey.
Quickly designed and developed multiple high quality microservices to meet launch deadlines. By simplifying requirements, designing extensible software, and guiding other engineers, I was able to prevent a launch delay of potentially several months.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer II
positions.description:
Supported, created, and designed new services to manage security risks for Amazon Retail software.
Developed event based microservices that supported analyzing all retail software and handled live traffic of up to 20 TPS.
Delivered Front End (React) application work that managed security exemption approvals. UI used by interns, engineers, and directors.

positions.title: Back End Developer
positions.description:
Developed microservices in Java & Scala with Integrations team to integrate with third party applications such as SAP and Yelp.
Delivered functionality that allowed clients to respond to and help manage Yelp reviews from the Spredfast portal.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description: Designed and Front End (React), Backend (Python/Django), and Database Model (Postgres) for application with expected > 30,000 daily users. Implemented the entire application with a team of 8 over several months.

positions.title: Junior Developer
positions.description:
Worked directly with clients as a single developer to deliver two full interactive website applications.
Continually exceeded clients expectations by beating deadlines and delivering useful but unrequested features.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
Worked with development team to create web applications targeted at companies with remote workers. 
Client Side: AngularJS 
Server Side: C#/C, ServiceStack, SQL

positions.title: Peer Teacher
positions.description: Assisted students during student labs and offices hours related to classroom assignments. Classes involved C++, C, and Python.

company.name: Department of Computer Science and Engineering at Texas A&M University

positions.title: IT Intern
positions.description: Worked with corporate HelpDesk to set up workstations and troubleshoot computer issues.
